notes.title: Updated on November 6, 2023
notes.content:
1. Modify the problem of continuing the game after the character dies and being unable to continue playing subsequent game content after clicking the "Continue" button.

notes.title: Major game update on October 20, 2023
notes.content:
The game has been released for more than a month. There were many problems when the game was first released. Thanks to all the players for their opinions and questions, the game is gradually improving.
This game update contains the following content:
1. The game will be released at a permanent price reduction. The price will be updated after the platform is approved ($1.99/￥11 will be reduced to $0.99/￥6). Players who want to buy it can wait a moment.
2. The game has removed the healthy game prompt page to allow players to play the game content faster.
3. The background music during the game is changed. The previous background music is not suitable.
4. Acknowledgments Regarding the modification of music usage content.
5. Trial version music-related content updates.
6. The content of the game is now relatively complete, and I need to find another job due to family reasons. There will be no major feature updates in the future. However, if you find any errors in the game content during the game, please point it out. After I see the errors, Corrections will be checked as soon as possible.
7. If you have any comments about the game, in addition to contacting me on the platform, you can also add your personal QQ or BILIBILI account. For BILIBILI, you can enter "Mr. Li doing odd jobs" to search.

notes.title: Updated on October 5, 2023

notes.title: Updated on September 29, 2023
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the music volume would be reset to 100 after entering other interfaces after adjusting it.
2.Modify some game content of "The Development of the Northwest Basis and the Northwest Red Army".
PS. I wish everyone a happy Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day!

notes.title: Updated on September 28, 2023
notes.content:
1. The game content playback in the game round is changed from automatic to manual, that is, every time the player clicks the "Continue" button, the next piece of content will be played.
2. The game mechanism of the sacrifice ending has been modified. Now after the player character is sacrificed, the player can choose to play the ending directly or continue the game, but the inevitable events triggered by subsequent games will no longer have results and trigger events will no longer be triggered.
3. The location labels of the stage maps in the game round will no longer be hidden after a delay of 0.5 seconds. Instead, they will be hidden after the player clicks the "Continue" button to promote the development of the plot.
4. Correct the settings-after adjusting the volume of music and sound effects, enter the setting interface again to find the position of the volume slider of music and sound effects.

notes.title: Updated on September 23

1. Added new music and sound effects to the game！
2. Added music and sound effects related settings.
3. About and thanks for adding music and sound effects list.
4.Fix the problem of background music playback(Updated multiple times today due to this issue).

notes.title: Updated on September 21st
notes.content:
1. The game is locked to 30 frames.

2. The default display mode of the game has been changed to window.

notes.title: The Long March 1934-1936 is now officially released!
notes.content:
Some descriptions of the game:
1. The gameplay of this game is relatively simple. Play as a mass/soldier/cadre following the Red Army and experience the arduous journey of the Long March.
2. Now (September 23, Beijing time), music and sound effects have been added to the game!
3. Now (September 19th, Beijing time) the game has canceled the script unlocking function, and all scripts can be played from the beginning!
4. Now (September 28th, Beijing time) the game content playback mechanism has been changed from automatic to automatic!
5. Now (September 28th, Beijing time), the game’s sacrificial ending mechanism has been modified to allow you to directly play the ending to end the game, or continue the game and wait until the script content has been played before playing the ending (still sacrificing the ending and ending the game)!
6. Now (October 3, Beijing time) the trial version will be updated simultaneously with the modifications of the official version (there are still 2 playable scenarios).
7. You can join QQ group 926706564 for discussion and communication.
8. In addition, if you find any problems with the game content during the game, you are welcome to point it out directly and I will check it and make modifications as soon as possible.
9. I hope all players have fun and can help you learn the essence of the Long March spirit.
